provenance.note: Covers EPF/EPS mechanics not already in the `fixed-income` pack (which carries the EPF/VPF interest rate itself — this pack does not duplicate it, see this file's own module doc comment in epf-rules.ts). The headline change this pack ships: the EPFO wage ceiling rose from ₹15,000/month to ₹25,000/month on 17 September 2026 (Gazette notification S.O. 5109(E), Labour Ministry) — the first revision since September 2014. This is the ceiling for mandatory EPFO coverage and for capping the EPS share of the employer's contribution; it is not a cap on total contributions, which many employers compute on uncapped actual wages by mutual agreement.

contribution.wageCeilingInr.note: ₹25,000/month, effective 17 September 2026, per Gazette notification S.O. 5109(E) under Chapter III of the Code on Social Security, 2020. Was ₹15,000/month from September 2014 until this change.

contribution.epsShareOfEmployerRate.note: 8.33% of the employer's 12% contribution goes to EPS, applied only up to the wage ceiling — so the maximum employer EPS contribution rose from ₹1,250/month (at the ₹15,000 ceiling) to ₹2,083/month (at the new ₹25,000 ceiling). The 8.33% rate itself did not change; only the ceiling it's applied to did.

withdrawal.taxFreeAfterYearsContinuousSe.note: Section 10(12): fully tax-exempt after 5 years of continuous service, with service at a previous employer counting toward the 5 years if the PF balance was transferred (via UAN) rather than withdrawn.

withdrawal.tdsRateWithPan.note: 10% TDS with PAN furnished, 20% without, on withdrawals above ₹50,000 before 5 years' continuous service; Form 15G/15H can eliminate TDS if the subscriber has no net tax liability.

eps.pensionDivisor.note: The EPS pension formula's divisor (pensionable salary × pensionable service ÷ 70) is widely cited but was not independently re-derived from a primary EPFO source this session — the EPFO EDLI/Pension calculator page that would confirm the current pensionable-salary ceiling returned a 403 to automated fetch. Flagged lower-confidence, same convention this project uses for Section 80D's section number; worth a direct manual check before this figure is relied on for anything beyond an illustrative estimate.

eps.pensionableSalaryCeilingInr.note: Set equal to the current wage ceiling (₹25,000), matching EPS's long-standing convention of capping pensionable salary at the same figure as the EPF wage ceiling — not independently confirmed to have moved in lockstep with the 17 Sep 2026 wage-ceiling change specifically. Same lower-confidence flag as eps.pensionDivisor above.

taxableInterest.thresholdWithEmployerCon.note: Budget 2021 (in force since FY2021-22): interest on the employee's own EPF+VPF contributions above ₹2,50,000/year is taxable at slab rate as "income from other sources." This is the same ₹2.5L figure already carried by the `fixed-income` pack's `products.epf.taxableInterestThresholdPerYear` — duplicated here, independently cited, because this pack's consumer (the EPF/VPF module's own simulator) needs it alongside the EPS/wage-ceiling mechanics that pack doesn't carry.

taxableInterest.thresholdWithoutEmployer.note: ₹5,00,000/year threshold, applicable only to a provident fund account with no employer contribution at all (e.g. a government employee's GPF) — not reachable by this module's simulator, which always models an employer-matched EPF account, but kept here for completeness.
